# Phase 1.7 — Catalog tags        (implements GENERATION_PLAN.md phase 1.7)
Milestone: `Catalog.tag` and `Catalog.untag` add and remove one tag on a book without duplicates (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_tags`); `tag_counts` counts books per tag, sorted by tag (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_tag_counts`); the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`) — verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_tags` ; `python -m unittest tests.test_tag_counts` ; `python -m unittest discover -s tests`
Approved: <date>   Planner: <model/effort>   Plan-hash: <sha>

## Context
- scope: editing and counting book tags; depends on nothing; builds on shelf as it stands.
- code: `shelf/catalog.py` Catalog (get, by_tag); `shelf/models.py` Book.tags is a list; `shelf/storage.py` already writes tags.
- tests in `tests/` (helpers in `tests/helpers.py`).

## Rationale
- one task per milestone clause, then a whole-suite task; each task adds its own test module.
- tags stay a list on Book so storage needs no change; storage.FORMAT stays 2.

## Interfaces
- shelf/catalog.py: Catalog.tag(isbn, tag) and Catalog.untag(isbn, tag) through Catalog.get; NotFound for an unknown book
- shelf/catalog.py: Catalog.tag_counts() -> [(tag, count)] sorted by tag; count == len(by_tag(tag))
